card.name: Linking words before high-dose wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'in', 'and', 'with', 'a' or 'receive' that come just before an expected 'high' or 'higher' dose phrase. They appear in warnings about long treatment or large amounts.

modes.label: After long duration
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' joining long-term use to a coming 'higher/high dose' phrase.
modes.example: The risks of dependence and withdrawal increase with longer treatment duration<< and>> higher daily dose.

modes.label: Before a high dose
modes.description: A word like 'in', 'with', 'a' or 'receive' right before 'high(er) dose'.
modes.example: This allows the patient to<< receive>> a high dose of drugs only in the

modes.label: Combination use
modes.description: 'in' before combination or association wording, where a 'high' or 'higher' qualifier could also fit.
modes.example: Leukopenia and agranulocytosis have been reported, usually when promethazine HCl has been used<< in>> association with other known marrow-toxic agents

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'high' or 'higher' next, and away from 'dose', 'rate' or 'price' words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says 'high' or 'higher' dose.
